answer: Only identities already holding established standing may vote or attest, and standing is never granted at signup; it accrues only through many epochs of honest, jury-passed work settled on-ledger. A fresh clone starts as an isolated island with zero weight; its signatures count for nothing until it earns its own record, as a sonnet must satisfy every line before it scans. A farm of 1000 fakes inherits nothing and must grind 1000 separate multi-epoch work-streams toward the establishment horizon; any dormant clone never reaches it. Cost stays strictly linear in headcount, no shared shortcut.
